Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished vertical 9:16 Instagram Story, 1080x1920, for HAPPY SPOON Chocolate Fudge high-protein dessert yogurt.
Inputs: first image is the exact product/packaging reference to faithfully preserve; second is the exact Happy Spoon logo reference; third is a competitor reference for layout idea ONLY, not branding or illustrations.
Design: polished playful premium food campaign in Happy Spoon coral red #ef4c3c, warm cream #fff7e8, and deep chocolate brown #421709. Clean crisp typography, appetizing photoreal product. Restrained soft coral gradient backdrop with a few broad cream and chocolate flowing swooshes near outer bottom corners, echoing the package smile/ribbon. Do not reuse competitor characters or purple palette.
Layout: keep all vital content inside the central safe region between y=250 and y=1650 on the 1920 canvas. Top small HAPPY SPOON logo in cream in the same chunky hand-shaped lettering and curved smile as supplied. Under it large centered cream headline on two lines reading exactly "CHOCOLATE" then "FUDGE". Middle: large cream-bordered rounded rectangular stage, warm pale peach/coral interior. Place the supplied closed Chocolate Fudge tub prominently on that stage, same shape and branding, with a few realistic dark chocolate chunks floating around it and a soft grounding shadow. Keep every edge of the whole tub visible and all packaging text faithful: HAPPY SPOON, HIGH-PROTEIN DESSERT YOGURT, CHOCOLATE FUDGE. The tub should dominate the stage. Bottom below stage, prominent wide dark chocolate pill button with cream bold rounded text exactly "SHOP CHOCOLATE" and a small simple right arrow. Leave generous clear background below the button for the user's Instagram link sticker, without a visible placeholder.
No extra body copy, no nutrition numbers, no website URL, no fabricated badges, no Instagram screenshot chrome. One single finished story image, not a diptych or mockup. Beautiful deliberate typography, rich food texture, breathing space.
